criteria.rationale: The visual of a single news anchor cannot align with the audio of five people dialoguing. The inserted treasure hunt has no semantic or temporal connection to the main sequence, breaking alignment. This is a major issue.

summary: Enhanced prompt contains severe internal inconsistencies across all criteria: subject identity and count are contradictory (one to five people), actions are incoherent (news anchor to dialogue among five people), chronology is reversed and infeasible (ending before beginning), spatial continuity is violated (static vs. moving camera), physics is ignored (same person as multiple identities), and temporal alignment is broken (2s total vs. 25s per shot). The prompt deliberately introduces contradictions and impossibilities, making it fundamentally inconsistent.
